description: Send a person of this tenant their personal connect link (see create_connect_link) so they connect their OWN calendar / meeting account (Google, Microsoft 365, IMAP) — e.g. a sales partner whose free slots you need. If the requested kinds are already connected for that person, NO link is created: returns already_connected:true with the accounts. Otherwise creates the link (only for the kinds still missing) and sends a short neutral message: what it is, which kinds it grants, until when it is valid, that it is personal and must not be forwarded, and that some Microsoft 365 organisations need a one-time admin approval. channel: email (default; the tenant's mailbox, same path as send_team_email), whatsapp (same path as send_whatsapp) or return_only (nothing is sent; you get url and message_preview). If the channel is not set up or the person has no address/number on file, it falls back to return_only and says why (fallback_reason). Without user_id it is for the caller; for someone else tenant admin only (same rule as create_connect_link). Returns { url, expires_at, kinds, sent_via, to, message_preview, already_connected_kinds }. Logged in the audit log (without the link). SENDS FOR REAL unless channel is return_only.

channel.description: How to deliver: email (default), whatsapp, or return_only (send nothing, just return the link and text).

days.description: Validity of the link in days, 1-14 (default 7).

kinds.description: Account kinds the link grants; default calendar and meetings. Kinds already connected are left out.

items.description: One account kind: mail, calendar, meetings or files

personal_note.description: Optional short personal line added to the message (max 500 characters).

to.description: Override recipient: e-mail address (email) or number in E.164 (whatsapp). Default: the person's login e-mail or profile phone.

user_id.description: The person (list_tenant_users) who should connect. Default: the caller. Someone else: tenant admin only.

name: send_connect_link
